standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of finite locally free degree
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the finite locally free property along the etale surjection.

core_obligations: Apply the scheme lemma to W x_X U -> U; obtain the closed subsets Y_r of U.
Base-change commutation of the stratification gives s^{-1}(Y_r) = t^{-1}(Y_r); the Y_r are R-invariant.
Descend: |Y_r| is the inverse image of a closed subset Z_r of |X|; give Z_r the reduced induced structure.
Verify the universal property for arbitrary g: T -> X via an etale surjection V -> T, the fplf-local definition, and the descent lemma.
proof_roadmap: Scheme stratification; R-invariance by base-change commutation; descent to X; universal-property verification.
difficulty_reason: The R-invariance step plus the two-part universal-property verification are the substance.
